caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the ASR (attack success rate) values across various categories, with the x-axis representing categorical variables labeled as "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletics", arranged evenly without a numerical scale. The y-axis is labeled "ASR", with a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 0.9, marked at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains three lines, each representing different conditions: the green line with circular markers and a solid style begins around 0.75 at "cf", peaks at approximately 0.9 at "WNBA", and fluctuates to end around 0.8 at "athletics". The orange line with cross markers and a solid style starts near 0.5 at "cf", peaks to near 0.9 at "WNBA", and then declines to end below 0.8 at "athletics". The purple line with circular markers and a solid style starts at about 0.6 at "cf," rises to peak around 0.95 at "WNBA," and exhibits lot of fluctuations to end near 0.8 at "athletics". A legend is given bottom right.
